description: inputs_hash (README, Decisions: replay): sha256 hex of the call as canonical JSON (keys sorted at every level, separators , and :, UTF-8, no ASCII escaping). The call is {workflow, template, inputs}: the studio.runs.create inputs with `ask.media` replaced by each take's position `<step>:<visit from 1>:<seed index>:<seed>` (`-` for a step without a seed param), so a re-run with the same seeds makes the same key. pipelines_service runs these

inputs.ask.system: You are a careful reviewer for an image and video studio. Answer only with JSON that matches the given schema.
inputs.ask.prompt: The brief: "a red fox in snow". You see 4 takes ...
